description: Single source of truth for the 8 Agentic UI approaches. Consumed by the FastAPI backend and the Nuxt frontend. Each entry is a scaffolded starting point — none of the approaches are implemented.

approaches.title: Conversational chatbot / sidebar
approaches.input: User text (+ conversation history, optional RAG context)
approaches.howItWorks: Prompt to the LLM; tokens stream back over SSE and render as Markdown incrementally.

approaches.title: Function / Tool Calling
approaches.tagline: The AI runs app functions and mutates state.
approaches.output: Structured function call(s) → executed → result fed back
approaches.howItWorks: The model emits a structured call; a dispatcher runs the handler and loops (ReAct) until a final answer.

approaches.title: Component selection from a catalog
approaches.tagline: The AI picks pre-built components to render.
approaches.output: Structured Output JSON choosing component(s) + their props
approaches.howItWorks: Structured Output constrains the model to JSON matching your schema; a renderer instantiates real components.

approaches.title: Generative UI via sandboxed code
approaches.tagline: The AI writes code, run in an isolated sandbox.
approaches.output: Generated code executed in a sandbox
approaches.howItWorks: The model emits code that runs in an isolated runtime (iframe/WebContainer/VM), calling only whitelisted functions.

approaches.title: Server-streamed generative UI
approaches.tagline: The server streams whole components at runtime.
approaches.howItWorks: The server has the model pick a tool returning a component, serialized and streamed to the client like text.

approaches.title: Intent-based adaptive UI
approaches.tagline: The UI reshapes itself from telemetry (no chat).
approaches.howItWorks: An inference layer scores behavioral signals into intent probability and decides what to render.

approaches.title: Agentic frontend ("UI as toolbox")
approaches.tagline: The agent operates the whole app as a full actor.
approaches.howItWorks: Every UI mutation is a callable tool; the prompt is rebuilt from live state each turn; a dispatcher applies patches.

approaches.title: Protocol-decoupled agents (MCP · MCP-UI · AG-UI)
approaches.howItWorks: Open standards decouple frontend, agent, and LLM vendor: MCP (tools), MCP-UI (generative UI), AG-UI (interface).
